description: JSON enum for the types of objects in Synapse.

enum.name: ENTITY
enum.description: An element of the file hierarchy, e.g., file project, folder

enum.name: ENTITY_CONTAINER
enum.description: An entity that can contain other entities

enum.name: PRINCIPAL
enum.description: A user or group of users

enum.name: ACTIVITY
enum.description: A provenance element, linking entities to provide their history

enum.name: EVALUATION
enum.description: An evaluation object, such as a challenge or competition.

enum.name: EVALUATION_ROUND
enum.description: Rounds defined within a specific Evaluation

enum.name: SUBMISSION
enum.description: A submission to an evaluation.

enum.name: EVALUATION_SUBMISSIONS
enum.description: A collection of submissions for an evaluation.

enum.name: FILE
enum.description: A file object, representing a file stored in Synapse.

enum.name: MESSAGE
enum.description: A message object, such as a notification or communication.

enum.name: WIKI
enum.description: A wiki page or documentation object.

enum.name: FAVORITE
enum.description: A user's favorite entity or object.

enum.name: ACCESS_REQUIREMENT
enum.description: An access requirement, such as terms of use or data use agreement.

enum.name: ACCESS_APPROVAL
enum.description: An approval for an access requirement.

enum.name: TEAM
enum.description: A team object, representing a group of users.

enum.name: TABLE
enum.description: A table object, representing tabular data.

enum.name: ACCESS_CONTROL_LIST
enum.description: An access control list (ACL) for managing permissions.

enum.name: PROJECT_SETTING
enum.description: A project setting or configuration object.

enum.name: VERIFICATION_SUBMISSION
enum.description: A submission for user or team verification.

enum.name: CERTIFIED_USER_PASSING_RECORD
enum.description: A record of a user passing the certified user test.

enum.name: FORUM
enum.description: A discussion forum object.

enum.name: THREAD
enum.description: A discussion thread in a forum.

enum.name: REPLY
enum.description: A reply to a thread in a forum.

enum.name: FORM_GROUP
enum.description: Grouping of form data.

enum.name: ORGANIZATION
enum.description: User defined schemas are governed by an Organization.

enum.name: FORM_DATA
enum.description: Data of a form.

enum.name: ENTITY_VIEW
enum.description: A view of entities, such as a file or project view.

enum.name: USER_PROFILE
enum.description: Details about a user, like name and organization

enum.name: DATA_ACCESS_REQUEST
enum.description: A request for access to data.

enum.name: DATA_ACCESS_SUBMISSION
enum.description: A submission for a data access request.

enum.name: DATA_ACCESS_SUBMISSION_STATUS
enum.description: The status of a data access submission.

enum.name: MEMBERSHIP_INVITATION
enum.description: An invitation to join a team

enum.name: JSON_SCHEMA
enum.description: A JSON schema.

enum.name: JSON_SCHEMA_DEPENDANT
enum.description: A JSON schema that references other schemas.

enum.name: DATASET
enum.description: A dataset is a view of a list of entities.

enum.name: DATASET_COLLECTION
enum.description: A dataset collection is a view of a list of datasets.

enum.name: THREAD_VIEW
enum.description: Object used to proxy thread views

enum.name: MATERIALIZED_VIEW
enum.description: A materialized view is defined by SQL run against one or more tables/views

enum.name: VIRTUAL_TABLE
enum.description: A virtual table is a common table expression that references one or more tables/views

enum.name: TABLE_STATUS_EVENT
enum.description: A change in the table status

enum.name: DATA_ACCESS_SUBMISSION_EVENT
enum.description: An event fired when a user submits a data access submission

enum.name: FILE_EVENT
enum.description: An event fired when a user uploads or downloads the file

enum.name: QUERY_CACHE_HIT
enum.description: An event fired when a user's query hits the query cache.

enum.name: PROJECT_STORAGE_EVENT
enum.description: An event fired when project storage change event needs to be propagated.

enum.name: REPLICATED_EVENT
enum.description: An event fired after an object has been replicated.

enum.name: PORTAL
enum.description: A representation of a Synapse portal.

enum.name: OAUTH_CLIENT
enum.description: An OAuth 2.0 Client.

enum.name: GRID_SESSION
enum.description: A grid session change that triggers index rebuilding.
